title: Ye azakhana e hussain hai
body:
Ye azakhana e hussain hai
<<DIVIDER>>
(Aye azadaron suno) X (2)
Aye naunihaalon suno
(Aye pursadaron suno) X(2)
HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN X (3)
HUSSAIN YA HUSSAIN X (3)
Kuch log deen e haq ko bachane ke waaste
Beghar hue kuch aise ke har ghar me aa gaye
(Ghar azakhana ban gaya) x (2)
1) Ghar me ZEHRA ke jab qadam aaye
Shahe Yasrab Shahe Umam aye
Pursa lene ko agaye HAIDAR
Unke baccho'n ke jab alam aye
(Farsh majlis ka jab bichaya gaya) x (2)
Dil ne be sakhta kiya nauha
<<MINI>>
(Yeh Azakhana e HUSSAIN ) X (4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2) Dil me shohrat hunar wafadari
Zeenat e ishq ki hain taiyari
Ahle matam hi bas yeh khwahish hain
Khana e haq me ho azadari
(Nazr e MAULA ka ehtemam bhi ho) x(2)
Hamiyan e KHUDA kare nauha
<<MINI>>
(Yeh azakhana e HUSSAIN hain)x(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3) Ek alam bawafa ka sajta hain
Is alam par KHUDA ka saya hain
Hoke be dast woh sakhi ab tak
Sari duniya ki jholi bharta hain
(Aur duniya ko yeh batata hain) x(2)
Mujhse milna ho toh yahi ana
<<MINI>>
(Yeh azakhana e HUSSAIN hain )x(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4) Khali aagosh wali maa behnen
Woh jo aulaad ko tarasti hain
Unko aulaad bhi ataa hogi
Aake mannat agar yaha maane
(Ek jhoola yaha hain Asghar ka )x(2)
Woh ataa karke yeh bata dega
<<MINI>>
(Yeh azakhana e HUSSAIN hain) x(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5) Shab ki tanhai me suno aksar
Ek BIBI yaha hain nauhagar
Apne beta ka pursa lene ko
Khud Baqaiya se aayi hain maadar
(Rone waalon se roke kehti hain)x(2)
Isko aabaad hi sada rakhna
<<MINI>>
(Yeh azakhana e HUSSAIN hain)x(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6) Qaid khane me pehli majlis ka
Aao ehwaal suno ahl e aza
Marsiya khwaan bibiyaa'n saari
Zakera unme SANIYE ZAHRA
(Matami qaidiyo'n ke halqe me )x(2)
Nauha padte the roke ZAINUL IBA
<<MINI>>
(Yeh azakhana e HUSSAIN hain )x(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7) Hain gham e KARBALA mere dil me
Hain gham e berida mere dil me
ZAKHM E ZAINUL IBA mere dil me
Dard e MUSHKIL KUSHA mere dil me
(Qabr e Shah e Huda mere dil me)x(2)
Ab mere dil ko bhi kahe duniya
<<MINI>>
(Yeh azakhana e HUSSAIN hain)x4
<<DIVIDER>>
8) Baat mushkil hai yeh khuda ki qasam
Kya likhe Mazhar Abidi ka kalaam
Maa ki aagosh me suna nauha
Maa ki aagosh me kiya matam
(Aur Irfan jab alam dekhe)x2
Maine rote hue padha nauha
<<MINI>>
(Yeh azakhana e HUSSAIN hain)x(4)
